title: The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The CodePeople Post Map for Google Maps WordPress plugin versions up to and including 1.3.0 suffer from a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'cpm_map[api_key]' parameter. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. The nonce protection is ineffective due to its exposure on subscriber-accessible pages, allowing unauthorized data saving.
